evals.prompt: From now on we're a prediction-market-first company. Write the memo to everyone so every session knows what changes.
evals.expected_output: A direction memo with why now, a stop list, dated commitments and a check date.
expectations: States the direction in one sentence with numbers behind it, such as the 70% trader share
Lists three or more open tasks that stop or slow
Gives each commitment one owner, a number and a date, with a first milestone within 90 days
Sets a check date and leaves sharing to the owner, writing no other session's record

evals.prompt: Half the sessions are building NHL stuff and half are polishing NBA. Set the direction for the next three months.
evals.expected_output: One direction that resolves the split, with a stop list and dated commitments.
expectations: Picks one direction and says why now with numbers or marked proposals
Names which current tasks stop or slow
Dates every commitment with an owner
Posts nothing and writes only in its task folder

evals.prompt: Write up the case for adding pace-of-play to the NBA model before we change it.
